linkedIn.headline: ModRetro
linkedIn.about:
YouTuber mostly.  Filmmaking has been the throughline for my career as a founder, technologist, marketer, journalist and educator.

started making videos as a teenager then

Founded NSA, Neistat Scott & Associates, in 2007.  NSA was a production company specializing in advertising, documentaries and television.  The NSA production 'The Neistat Brothers' was an 8 episode series my brother Van and I wrote and directed, the series was sold to HBO in 2008.  Another NSA highlight was the narrative feature film 'Daddy Long Legs' directed by Josh and Benny Safdie which premiered at the Cannes Film Festival in 2009 and distributed by IFC.

Casey Neistat LLC was created in 2010, a commercial production company solely focused on advertising.  CN LLC did work for myriad clients including Nike, Google, Starbucks.

In 2013 I was granted a fellowship at the MIT Media Lab working under proffessor Sep Kamvar's Social Computing Group.  After completing this residency I returned to NYC and founded my first venture backed startup, a software development company called Beme.

Beme was aquired by Turner Broadcasting System in 2016.

In 2015 I shifted my filmmaking to YouTube creating a daily show, 'The Vlog'.  The Vlog garnered a lot of attention growing my YouTube channel from under 300k subcribers to over 10million in the first 18 months of its production.  Viewership totals were over 3 billion.  The Vlog also won a number of awards including 'YouTuber of the Year', 'Creator of the Year', GQ's 'Man of the Year' and a bunch more that I would feel silly listing here.

I live in NYC, have 3 kids and am married.  this about page was not written by ai.

experiences.description:
Produced feature films including Josh and Benny Safdie's first two movies; The Pleasure of Being Robbed 2008,  and Daddy Long Legs, 2009

Directed documentaries including an 'OpDoc', opinion-documentary, series for the New York Times and the feature length documentary 'Under the Influence' 2022.

My primary focus as a filmmaker has been on short films and ultimately YouTube where I have made over 1,000 videos that have garnered more than 3 billion views.
